Samira V: Hi team — quick Q: I extended my conference trip by one night for personal travel. Hotel folio shows 3 nights (2 business, 1 personal) on one bill paid on company card. How should I split the charge and how does per diem apply for the personal day?
Jordan (People Ops): Good Q. Best practice: split the hotel charges so the company is only billed for business nights. If company card was used accidentally for the personal night, reimburse company for that night ASAP and attach manager approval for the split. Per diem only covers business days.
Samira V: Got it. Manager approved the two business nights. I can reimburse the personal night — can I just expense a negative line or do I need a separate refund?
Finance Bot: Policy: Do not use negative expense lines. If company card was charged for a personal night, employee must either 1) have hotel issue a refund to the company card and provide refund confirmation, OR 2) submit a personal reimbursement to Finance by attaching the hotel folio and a copy of a personal card payment or internal repayment evidence. Please include a short attestation in the expense report.
Samira V: OK will ask hotel for a refund. If they refuse, I'll do internal repayment. For per diem: my conference day schedule had dinners covered by sponsor on day 2. Do I still claim per diem for that calendar day?
Jordan (People Ops): If meals are provided by third party (sponsor, client) for a business day, employees should deduct the meal value from per diem only when itemized deduction is required. Our policy: per diem is reduced by the number of meals provided when meals are clearly part of the business event. Add a note: "Sponsor-provided dinner on 10/12 - deduct per diem meal" and attach sponsor confirmation (email or agenda).
Hotel Admin (Ruth): For refunds: hotels often require front desk to process a refund to the original card. If company card cannot be refunded quickly, request a credit and we can offset on next invoice. Submit folio with line-item breakdown so Finance can reconcile.
Alex G: Quick bookkeeping Q — does the VAT on the refunded night matter? The folio shows VAT for all nights.
Finance Bot: VAT treatment: if company ultimately bears the refund (i.e., company card was charged and later refunded), VAT will net out on the vendor invoice. If the employee reimburses the company, Finance will record VAT according to the original vendor invoice; reclaim eligibility depends on country rules. Attach full folio showing VAT lines. Finance will handle reclaim evaluation.
Samira V: Thanks. Last Q: any note about incidentals? I used room minibar on the personal night only.
Jordan (People Ops): Incidentals tied to personal nights are employee responsibility. Make sure the folio separates incidentals per night or show receipts. If incidental was charged to the company and is personal, follow the same refund/repayment flow.
Samira V: Thanks everyone — I'll request the refund now and upload folio + sponsor email.
Finance Bot: Received comment: please tag expense "hotel-split-refund-pending" and include manager approval screenshot to speed up processing. Manual review may apply.
